doc: Zeroes out any entry in a 6-element array of 8-byte structs at D_80083D08 whose flags halfword (offset 0x4) has bit 0 set.

globals.name: D_80083D08
globals.decl: extern S_80083D08 D_80083D08[6]; // struct S_80083D08 { u32 unk0; u16 flags; u16 unk6; } (size 8); field 'flags' at offset 0x4 tested against bit 0x1 to decide whether to bzero(8) that slot

calls: extern void bzero(void *ptr, s32 n); -- standard library bzero(void*, size)
